capabilities: Color traits by rarity and size convention
Theme statblocks for Starfinder 2e via sf2e-stats blocks
Localize trait coloring across supported languages

problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display Pathfinder 2e statblocks with proper formatting, trait coloring, and action icons from plain Markdown.

relations.evidence: Shout out to the robust multilingual PF2e community on Foundry VTT; you guys' work was a huge help

summary: Markdown-based renderer that draws Pathfinder 2e and Starfinder 2e statblocks from pf2e-stats codeblocks.
